scope: Independent bounded review of lead-recovered official published 2040 output, exact tag reference, compiler and configuration. No upstream cost compilation or manual interpolation executed.
controlling_delta: User explicitly accepts direct or native-compiled 2040 technology-data v0.14.0 authority; 2050 proxy is not default and diagnostic stress is not blocking where direct horizon authority exists.

pin.evidence: Recovered original GitHub tag_ref.json maps refs/tags/v0.14.0 directly to commit efb1c45dee0b26e402fec66ce209c89474bc2d1f. Local PyPSA-Eur accepted dataset index independently reviewed previously pins v0.14.0.
pin.acquisition_scope: Source files recovered by the lead from the official tag; independently read and byte-hashed here. This review does not claim compiler re-execution from all original workbooks.

compiler_DEA_interpolation.semantics: For each source parameter row, upstream np.interp evaluates all configured target years from the available DEA year columns; remaining missing values are forward filled. Empty expectation retains the available central source-year columns instead of replacing them by a 2020/2050 uncertainty-endpoint path.

compiler_manual_source_interpolation.semantics: Upstream native compiler evaluates configured years using np.interp over each manual source parameter's year/value rows. This is upstream technology-data compilation semantics, not a MEM hand interpolation of 2050.

compiler_output_selection.semantics: Compiler loops over configured years, selects that year's parameter column, and writes the corresponding year-named published CSV.

native_year_support.acceptance: Published outputs/costs_2040.csv from the accepted pinned tag is a native horizon authority; reproducing the upstream compiler is unnecessary when the published output exists.

cost_structure.generation_description: Published offwind investment explicitly states grid connection costs subtracted.
cost_structure.discount_rate_authority: Unchanged local PyPSA-Eur technology discount-rate fill, not social_discountrate.

wind_parameters.description: 21 Offshore turbines:  Nominal investment [MEUR/MW_e, 2020] grid connection costs subtracted from investment costs

wind_parameters.source: Danish Energy Agency, Technology Data for Energy Transport (July 2025), https://ens.dk/en/analyses-and-statistics/technology-data-transport-energy, Excel datasheet: 1.8 el substations. Including onshore and offshore substation.
Danish Energy Agency, Technology Data for Energy Transport (July 2025), https://ens.dk/en/analyses-and-statistics/technology-data-transport-energy, Excel datasheet: 1.7 el trans AC&DC cables.
Danish Energy Agency, Technology Data for Energy Transport (July 2025), https://ens.dk/en/analyses-and-statistics/technology-data-transport-energy, Excel datasheet: 1.7 el trans AC&DC cables.

cost_structure.unit_validation: Published generation/station investments are EUR/kW variants and normalize by 1000 to EUR/MW. Cable investments are EUR/MW/km. FOM is percent/year, lifetime is years; native siting uses full-year annualized cost / (8760 * accepted cell CF).

price_basis.compiler_semantics: Before saving each year's output, compiler requests adjust_for_inflation for every technology using config eur_year=2025. Published currency_year and unit/description annotations still preserve original source years.
price_basis.clarification_of_prior_annotation_only_r: New compiler/config evidence distinguishes upstream requested 2025-EUR output normalization from retained source currency-year annotations. No accepted 2050 numerical data changes follow from this clarification.

unchanged_2050.role: Existing accepted direct native 2050 authority remains byte-identical; new 2040 authority supplies separate horizon coefficients.

limitations: This bounded source review establishes published pin/year/parameter semantics, not the lead's updated 21 offshore allocation/profile outputs. Those affected outputs require their separate cached-transform verification.
